Looking for an alternative night out in London?

Then look no further, Roller Disco at London’s only purpose built nightclub on wheels provides fun filled events for all the family!

Roller Nation hold a range of events and sessions for everyone to enjoy including a Family Jam skating session and a range of quirky club nights over the course of the weekend. Complete with a line-up of the hottest DJ’s, a licensed indoor bar, tasty diner serving hot food all over the weekend and a great outdoor seating area to chill with your friends.

Tickets for Roller Nations Club Nights are available online and are at high demand, it is recommended to book your tickets to ensure entry on the night.

Want to make your night in London even more special?

The opportunity to book and reserve a booth is now available online! Book now to secure your perfect, one stop, night out on wheels.
